news_lookback.older_context_rule: Only include older news when it is necessary context for a current catalyst, market reaction, contract, regulatory action, earnings event, or thesis change. Clearly label it as context, not fresh news.

focus_categories: mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, IPO/SPAC activity, activist stakes, strategic investments, joint ventures, and major partnerships

new technological innovations, product launches, commercialization milestones, AI/compute, semiconductors, robotics/autonomy, space/satellite, defense tech, cybersecurity, energy/grid/nuclear, biotech/medtech, fintech/payments, manufacturing, and materials
government contracts, grants, procurement awards, public-private programs, defense/aerospace awards, infrastructure/chips/energy funding, and agency budget allocations
regulatory and legal catalysts such as approvals, bans, antitrust, export controls, tariffs, sanctions, CFIUS, FDA/FTC/DOJ/SEC actions, and congressional activity with company exposure

supply-chain and real-world operating developments affecting SpaceX/Starlink and satellite suppliers, defense/aerospace suppliers, energy infrastructure, shipping/logistics, labor, cyber, commodities, manufacturing capacity, and cloud/data-center capex
watchlist-specific company news, filings, earnings/guidance, analyst actions, contracts, partnerships, product launches, legal/regulatory issues, and competitive changes
deprioritized_topics: routine Federal Reserve or interest-rate commentary unless tied to a concrete company/sector catalyst
generic market/index tone such as whether the market is neutral, mixed, bullish, or bearish
broad macro summaries without a clear link to public companies, sectors, suppliers, customers, or competitors
market_impact_topics_always_scan: large mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, IPO/SPAC activity, activist stakes, strategic investments, joint ventures, and major partnerships

new technological innovations and product/commercial breakthroughs in AI, semiconductors, robotics, autonomy, cloud/data-center infrastructure, space/satellite, defense tech, cybersecurity, energy/grid/nuclear, biotech/medtech, fintech/payments, manufacturing, and materials
large government contracts, procurement awards, grants, public-private programs, agency budget allocations, and defense/aerospace awards
regulatory, antitrust, FDA, FTC, DOJ, SEC, CFIUS, congressional, export-control, tariff, sanctions, and approval/ban actions with clear company or sector exposure
major private-company activity that affects public markets, including SpaceX, Starlink, OpenAI, Anthropic, Stripe, Databricks, and defense/AI suppliers
supply-chain changes affecting semiconductors, aerospace, defense, energy, shipping, autos, manufacturing, and cloud infrastructure
major earnings, guidance, layoffs, bankruptcies, credit events, legal outcomes, cyber incidents, labor actions, and operational disruptions

prefer: official company releases and investor relations
procurement, grant, and agency award notices
credible industry publications for defense, space, semiconductors, energy, supply chains, AI, cybersecurity, and biotech
